caption: The drawing depicts a shallow, wide silver bowl with a short, rounded pedestal base. The bowl is rendered in shades of gray, mimicking a metallic sheen and curvature. Centered on the front of the bowl, there is an engraved image of a horse and rider in profile, galloping to the right. Above the engraved figure, there is an inscription around the upper rim of the bowl that reads: "This Plate Won By A Horse, CaP OLD Tenor Belonging To Lewis Moris, Jun." Above the bowl, outside the sketched frame, the same inscription is repeated in a rectangular text box accompanied by the date “Octo 9th 1757.” The drawing is done on a light, beige paper, and the linework appears in pencil or graphite, providing a precise, monochromatic representation. The name “G. Caselli” is signed in the bottom right corner of the drawing. The composition is centered and organized, with a rectangular border framing the bowl and inscription.
title: Silver Bowl
